description: This file defines the SupportClient class in the AWS Support namespace, extending AwsClient and specifying methods for AWS Support operations with associated asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: SupportClient
classes.description: AWS Support client class providing methods to interact with AWS Support API.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToSet
methods.description: Adds attachments to a support case or set.

methods.name: addAttachmentsToSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds attachments to a support case or set.

methods.name: addCommunicationToCase
methods.description: Adds a communication to an AWS Support case.

methods.name: addCommunicationToCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a communication to an AWS Support case.

methods.name: createCase
methods.description: Creates a new AWS Support case.

methods.name: createCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new AWS Support case.

methods.name: describeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves details about an attachment.

methods.name: describeAttachmentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about an attachment.

methods.name: describeCases
methods.description: Lists AWS Support cases.

methods.name: describeCasesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists AWS Support cases.

methods.name: describeCommunications
methods.description: Lists communications for a support case.

methods.name: describeCommunicationsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists communications for a support case.

methods.name: describeCreateCaseOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for creating support cases.

methods.name: describeCreateCaseOptionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves options for creating support cases.

methods.name: describeServices
methods.description: Lists AWS support services.

methods.name: describeServicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists AWS support services.

methods.name: describeSeverityLevels
methods.description: Lists severity levels for support cases.

methods.name: describeSeverityLevelsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists severity levels for support cases.

methods.name: describeSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Lists supported languages for support cases.

methods.name: describeSupportedLanguagesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists supported languages for support cases.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckRefreshStatuses
methods.description: Gets refresh statuses for Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckRefreshStatusesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets refresh statuses for Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckResult
methods.description: Retrieves result of a specific Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckResultAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves result of a specific Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckSummaries
methods.description: Provides summaries of Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorCheckSummariesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously provides summaries of Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorChecks
methods.description: Lists all Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: describeTrustedAdvisorChecksAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all Trusted Advisor checks.

methods.name: refreshTrustedAdvisorCheck
methods.description: Refreshes a specific Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: refreshTrustedAdvisorCheckAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes a specific Trusted Advisor check.

methods.name: resolveCase
methods.description: Resolves a support case.

methods.name: resolveCaseAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves a support case.
